summary: Hinge Health filed an 8-K reporting Q2 2026 results and a board-approved increase to its existing share repurchase program. The board expanded the authorization by $300 million, bringing total authorized repurchases to $496.5 million, with $196.5 million already spent as of July 29, 2026. Repurchases may occur via open market or private transactions, subject to Rule 10b-18. This is a capital return event, though routine earnings disclosure is also present. Watch for execution pace and remaining authorization as signals of ongoing capital allocation.
